official.deadline_note: The application period opens on the day students receive the Notification of Selection Results and stays open only a few days; in the 2026 round it ran 26 March to 30 March 2026, closing 23:59 CET. The next cycle's dates are set by the notification date and are not published in advance.
official.application_cycle: Annual round tied to the First Notification of Selection Results (usually end of March)
official.status_note: Official page: 'The application period for LiU Scholarships opens each year on the day students receive the Notification of Selection Results, and is only open for a short window.' The published 2026 dates were 26 March open, 30 March close at 23:59 CET, 10 April recipients published.
official.tuition_coverage_note: Official wording: 'The tuition fees for a student awarded a LiU International Scholarship are normally reduced by 50%.' The rules state 'The scholarship covers the total tuition fee or part of the tuition fee.'
benefits: A tuition-fee reduction for the awarded master's programme, normally 50% of the tuition fee
No additional documents are needed to support the scholarship application
Continued into the following academic year if at least 75% of first-year courses are passed

No separate scholarship documents; the application is made through the invited link

Institutional rankings, which are considered as part of the evaluation process
Any other relevant information shared in the registration form

application_method: Apply for a master's programme at Linköping University in the first admission round, ranking a LiU programme as first priority and submitting all documents by the deadline
Wait for the First Notification of Selection Results and confirm admission to your first choice
Respond to the personal email invitation to apply, sent when the application period opens
Complete the scholarship application by the closing date (30 March 2026, 23:59 CET in the 2026 round)
official.application_route: Apply and be admitted in the first round with a LiU master's ranked first, then respond to the emailed invitation and apply within the few days the window is open.
official.citizenship_residency: Citizen of a country outside the EU/EES/Switzerland and required to pay tuition fees; the scholarship lapses if your status changes to non-fee-payer.
official.international_eligibility: Open to fee-paying master's applicants from outside the EU/EES/Switzerland only.
official.duration: The specific year and master's programme stated in the Notification of Selection Results; the scholarship/fee normally covers a workload of 30 credits per semester
official.description: The LiU International Scholarship supports international master's degree students with significant academic potential who are required to pay tuition fees, with tuition fees normally reduced by 50%. Linköping University states it offers a limited number of these scholarships to new students and reserves the right to decide internally each year how many are offered and on what terms.
official.program_type: University-administered partial tuition-fee scholarship for fee-paying master's students

applicant_utility.summary: This award is the hardest of the Swedish university scholarships to plan around, because the window opens on the day the First Notification of Selection Results is published and closes just days later - in 2026 that meant four days, ending 23:59 CET on 30 March. You cannot apply in advance; you apply only if you are admitted to a LiU master's ranked first among your four choices, so the ranking decision in autumn effectively decides your eligibility. The reduction is normally 50% of the tuition fee, which still leaves a substantial fee plus all living costs to fund. New 2026 eligibility rules set a floor of GPA 3.5 on a 4.0 scale (roughly 75% or above in India, 80-85% or above in China, 8.0/10 or above on a 10-point scale), and files below that floor are simply not considered.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Fee-paying master's applicants just over the 3.5/4.0 academic floor who have ranked a LiU programme first and can absorb roughly half the tuition fee themselves.
application_readiness_checklist: Rank a LiU master's programme as number 1 of 4 before the first admission round deadline - this is the single decisive choice
Submit every required document before the first-round deadline; late documents end the scholarship route regardless of admission
Check your transcript against the published equivalents (India, China and 10-point CGPA scales) and work out whether you clear 3.5/4.0
Keep the end-of-March period free and watch the mailbox including spam, since the invitation email is the only trigger
Plan the permit and housing timeline around the 10 April recipient publication, not around a fixed calendar date
common_rejection_risks: Ranking a LiU programme second or lower, which removes eligibility entirely
Being admitted to another programme and assuming you can transfer the scholarship to it - the university states this is not possible
Falling below the GPA 3.5/4.0 floor, which was introduced for 2026 and makes the file ineligible
Missing the few-day window because the invitation email arrived in a spam folder
Also holding a Swedish Institute scholarship, which causes the LiU scholarship to be rescinded
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The remaining tuition after a normally-50% reduction, living costs, travel and residence-permit costs, and any fee for coursework beyond the 30 credits per semester covered by the award.
document_audit: No scholarship-specific documents exist - the application is made through the invited link, so your programme application file is the whole evidence base
Institutional ranking of your previous university is considered, which you cannot change but should be aware of
Only course results registered on 1 July in the regular academic year count toward the 75% pass test for renewal
You must study 30 credits per semester within the programme; extra credits outside that carry an additional fee
The 2026 recipient list is published as a PDF on the page, which shows the scale of the award
alerts: The scholarship is rescinded if you are awarded a Swedish Institute scholarship instead - the two cannot be combined
It is also rescinded if you cannot obtain a residence permit in time for registration
It lapses if your fee status changes to non-fee-payer, and you must inform LiU in writing if that happens
You must pass at least 75% of first-year courses to keep the award for the following year (45 of 60 credits by 1 July)
LiU reserves the right to change the number of scholarships, the percentage and the merit process each year
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: First-round application with LiU ranked first and documents complete, admission in the First Notification of Selection Results, then the invited scholarship application submitted within days of that notification.
